title: There is no navigation at all on phones — Review, Stats and Profile are unreachable
detail: The sidebar is `hidden sm:flex`, and the only mobile affordance rendered is the floating Add Book button. Below the 640px breakpoint a user can see their library and add books, but has no route to /review, /stats or /profile, and no way to switch profiles or reach settings. Three of the four nav destinations, including the entire spaced-repetition feature, simply do not exist on mobile.

title: Only two of six AI call sites can route the user to the key dialog
detail: handleAiError opens ApiKeyDialog on missing/invalid-key, and only AddBookModal and ChatModal receive it. BookDetail (audio, deep dive), EReader (audio) and QuizModal all call toast.error(toAiError(e).message) directly, so an invalid key there produces a toast telling the user to 'check it in Settings' — a screen that does not exist (feature-discovery F013) — and no way to open the dialog.

title: Closing the audio player is where the blob URL should be revoked, and is not
detail: onClose drops the track reference but nothing calls URL.revokeObjectURL. This is the single owner of the track's lifetime, so the leaks created in BookDetail (S036) and EReader have no place to be released.

title: Daily-wisdom dedup key uses toDateString(), a locale- and timezone-dependent string
detail: The stored marker is a local-time, locale-formatted date. Travelling across a timezone, or a browser locale change, can re-show or suppress the modal for a day. Every other timestamp in the app is stored as ISO UTC.

title: No skip-to-content link ahead of a 4-item persistent nav
detail: Keyboard users tab through the logo, four nav links, the profile card, switch-profile and add-book on every route change before reaching page content.

title: Switch-profile hover state is light-only
detail: hover:bg-red-50 has no dark pairing, so the hover wash disappears in dark mode.
